name: Change Password
summary: Attempts authenticated self-service replacement of the current password credential for the existing durable identity.

requiredInputs.description: Current password proof supplied through the deterministic credential UI.
Replacement password supplied through the deterministic credential UI.
Authenticated durable identity whose password credential is being replaced.

guards.expression: session-capability is authenticated and durable-identity == resolved

sourceReferences.note: Typed flow handler executes this action and selects the canonical result transition.
PasswordManager validates the authenticated request and delegates credential replacement.
Confirm-password mismatch remains client presentation validation and is intentionally not a server action input.
